findings.highlight: the man I believed could save anyone
findings.evidenceJa: 全ての人間を救えるだろう男
findings.governingReading: the man Shirou believed could save everyone
findings.explanation: The defining universal scope becomes the looser ability to save any individual person.

findings.evidenceJa: あったのは反発だけだ。
findings.governingReading: all Shirou felt was rebellious rejection
findings.explanation: An emotional rejection of Kiritsugu’s limit becomes the abstract and unnatural “felt resistance.”

findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: ally of justice
findings.explanation: The work’s central relational ideal is again replaced by a generic Western superhero category.

findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方そのものの人物
findings.governingReading: the person who, to Shirou, embodied the ally of justice itself
findings.explanation: Shirou’s subjective identification of Kiritsugu with the ideal becomes a literal genre identity.

findings.evidenceJa: それからの衛宮士郎の時間
findings.governingReading: all of Emiya Shirou’s time from then onward
findings.explanation: A period beginning with Kiritsugu’s words is broadened to Shirou’s entire life.

findings.evidenceJa: “ああ安心した”
findings.governingReading: “Ah. I’m relieved.”
findings.explanation: The short final quotation contains mismatched quotation and bracket debris.

findings.highlight: I cannot look away from his last moment.
findings.evidenceJa: その最期に、背を向ける事はできない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot turn his back on what Kiritsugu entrusted at the end.
findings.explanation: A refusal to abandon Kiritsugu’s dying legacy becomes visual inability to look away from the death scene.

findings.highlight: nor can one seek happiness without hurting others.
findings.evidenceJa: 誰も傷つけない幸福なんてない。
findings.governingReading: there is no happiness that harms no one
findings.explanation: The nonexistence of harmless happiness becomes a claim about whether one may seek it.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎が成ろうとする正義の味方
findings.governingReading: the ally of justice Emiya Shirou is trying to become
findings.explanation: A chosen identity and process of becoming are recast as an abstract search for a genre concept.

findings.evidenceJa: 偽りのような人生
findings.governingReading: a life resembling a falsehood
findings.explanation: A simile expressing the life’s apparent falsity becomes the categorical judgment that it is false.

findings.evidenceJa: 同じもの。
findings.governingReading: They are the same thing.
findings.explanation: The separate assertion of essential sameness disappears into shared origins.

findings.evidenceJa: 十一時過ぎ
findings.governingReading: sometime after eleven
findings.explanation: The checked time is shifted earlier to exactly eleven.

findings.evidenceJa: 正座したまま
findings.governingReading: remaining seated formally in seiza
findings.explanation: A precise formal posture becomes a vague cultural label.

findings.evidenceJa: 酷使した魔術回路
findings.governingReading: the Magic Circuits he had used so brutally
findings.explanation: The plural circuit system is reduced to one circuit.

findings.highlight: She hesitates to finish her sentence.
findings.evidenceJa: 辛そうに言い淀んだ。
findings.governingReading: She trails off with visible pain.
findings.explanation: Saber’s distress at naming Archer’s identity disappears.

findings.highlight: I have to settle my score with him.
findings.evidenceJa: アイツとだけは、俺が決着をつけなくちゃいけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou himself must bring matters with Archer to a conclusion
findings.explanation: The necessary self-confrontation acquires an unsupported revenge or grievance frame.

findings.evidenceJa: 凛とした声
findings.governingReading: her dignified, resolute voice
findings.explanation: Saber’s commanding composure becomes simple vocal clarity.

findings.evidenceJa: 坊主とヤツの殺し合い
findings.governingReading: the fight to the death between Shirou and Archer
findings.explanation: Lancer’s explicit recognition of the duel’s mutual lethal stakes disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 飄々とセイバーの視線を流している。
findings.governingReading: Lancer breezily lets Saber’s glare slide past him.
findings.explanation: Playful, untroubled deflection becomes blunt disregard.

findings.evidenceJa: にやにやと
findings.governingReading: watching them with a broad, knowing smirk
findings.explanation: Lancer’s teasing expression becomes a neutral smile.

findings.highlight: we have some time until we get to the castle.
findings.evidenceJa: 城までは随分とある。
findings.governingReading: It is a considerable distance to the castle.
findings.explanation: The scale of the journey becomes an unspecified amount of time.

findings.highlight: Lancer follows us from a distance.
findings.evidenceJa: 飄々と付いてくる。
findings.governingReading: Lancer follows at a maintained distance with his usual breezy nonchalance.
findings.explanation: The distance remains, but Lancer’s characteristic untroubled manner disappears.

findings.highlight: I know how far the castle is from here.
findings.evidenceJa: ここから城までの行程は把握している。
findings.governingReading: Shirou knows the route and stages of the journey from here to the castle.
findings.explanation: Knowledge of the route and travel course narrows to distance alone.

findings.evidenceJa: 主のいなくなった森の古城
findings.governingReading: the old castle in the forest, now without its master
findings.explanation: The forest setting and the elegiac absence of the castle’s owner collapse into the adjective “masterless.”
